payload.summary: Format new Encephalon record JSON with Biome before committing; lint checks encephalon/ and multi-line single-item arrays fail it.
lessons: encephalon add writes two-space JSON that can differ from Biome formatting, for example a one-item supersedes array split across lines.
Run bun x ultracite fix (or biome format --write on the new records) and then bun run lint after every encephalon add, not only before the code change.

searchText: Encephalon record JSON format Biome ultracite lint supersedes array commit
subject: workflow.format-encephalon-records
